title: Stop letting social media control your emotions.
paragraphs: Stop letting social media control your emotions.

Isang scroll lang — galit ka na.
Isang headline lang — takot ka na.
Isang comment lang — triggered ka na.

And most of the time…
hindi mo pa alam kung verified ba.

If your peace can be stolen by a post,
baka masyado nang malakas ang influence ng feed kaysa faith.
📖 “For God is not a God of confusion but of peace.” – 1 Corinthians 14:33

Hindi lahat ng trending dapat patulan.
Hindi lahat ng issue kailangan mong saluhin emotionally.

Discernment is spiritual maturity.
Peace is power.

Before you react:
Pray.
Pause.
Process.
Then respond — if needed.
You are called to be light, not algorithm-controlled.
“Be honest — when was the last time a post ruined your mood?”
